perspective:
From Christian Mensah’s subjective perspective, he has access to the following information:

- He is a police officer. Jonathan Balogun is his childhood best friend; Christian often seeks Jonathan’s advice and values his more educated perspective.
- Christian recently felt Jonathan was hiding something important and acting differently, which made him anxious and suspicious.
- Christian arranged and attended a meeting with Jonathan at their favorite coffee shop to confront him.
- Christian told Jonathan he felt something was being hidden. Jonathan initially said Christian could trust him, then admitted he had been keeping something from Christian: Jonathan is in some kind of trouble and did not know how to tell him.
- Christian became worried and empathetic, offered help, and said they could face it together.
- Jonathan said the situation is complicated, did not want to drag Christian into it, but could use support and resources to figure a way out of the mess.
- Christian asked whether the trouble was related to anything illegal. Jonathan said he could not say for sure, that he might have gotten involved with the wrong people, but that he did not do anything illegal himself.
- Christian decided to look into the matter discreetly without alarming Jonathan. Jonathan thanked him and said he trusted Christian to handle it carefully.
- Through Christian’s investigation, he learned/believed Jonathan was being framed—someone was trying to set Jonathan up. Christian told Jonathan this.
- At that stage, Christian did not yet know who was responsible; he had some leads and planned to gather more evidence to prove Jonathan’s innocence. Jonathan thanked him.
- Later, Christian found out/believed the real culprit was someone both he and Jonathan knew and trusted. He felt betrayed and resolute.
- Christian told Jonathan he had found out who was behind it, that it was someone close to them both, and that he intended to confront them and bring them to justice. Jonathan warned him the person is dangerous but said he trusted Christian.
